# Heartbeat: Surface Audit Progress and Completion Notifications

## Problem statement

The heartbeat skill runs audits headlessly via `pi -p --mode json --no-session /skill:audit <id>` when the completed/in_review queue reaches 10+ items. From the producer's perspective this work is invisible: there is no live view, no progress signal, and no notification when the audit completes. The audit either lands silently or fails silently (timeout/error) — see the evaluation of Pi subprocess mechanisms (discovered-from:WL-0MSG4VSP10020NL7), which identified this as the main visibility gap of headless pi usage.

## Users

- **Producers / operators** — want to know when a background heartbeat audit starts, is running, and finishes (with its verdict), so they can review results without polling the worklog.

Example user stories:

- "As a producer, when the heartbeat starts an audit, I want to see a notification so I know background work is happening."
- "As a producer, when a heartbeat audit completes, I want the result (Ready to close: Yes/No) surfaced so I don't have to discover it by chance."
- "As a producer, when a heartbeat audit fails or times out, I want that surfaced too, with the reason."

## Expected behaviour

- On heartbeat audit start: surface a notification (e.g. herdr toast and/or a work-item comment).
- On completion: surface the verdict ('Ready to close: Yes/No') — e.g. via toast, work-item comment, or both.
- On failure/timeout: surface the failure reason.

## Suggested implementation approach

- Extend the heartbeat skill (`.pi/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md` and `scripts/heartbeat.py`) to emit notifications around the `pi -p` audit invocation.
- Reuse existing notification plumbing where available (herdr `notification show` used by the worklist plugin's `notify.ts`; `wl comment add` for a durable record on the audited item).
- Consider an opt-out flag/env var so automated environments (cron, CI) can suppress noisy notifications.

## Acceptance criteria

1. When the heartbeat dispatches an audit, a visible start notification is produced.
2. When the audit completes, the verdict ('Ready to close: Yes/No') is surfaced via a notification and/or a comment on the work item.
3. When the audit fails or times out, the failure is surfaced with the reason.
4. Notifications are non-blocking (heartbeat continues to exit 0 on success) and can be suppressed for unattended environments.
5. Existing heartbeat tests still pass; new tests cover start/completion/failure notification paths.
6. All related documentation (SKILL.md) is updated to reflect the changes.
7. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

# Implement version read + dimmed right-aligned header display

## Summary
Read the plugin version at runtime from `packages/herdr/package.json` and render it as a dimmed, right-aligned `v<version>` suffix in the work item selection list header, without disturbing the left-aligned title.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A runtime helper reads the plugin version from `packages/herdr/package.json` (JSON parse via `readFileSync`, following the `shortcut-config.ts` pattern); when the file is missing or unparseable it falls back gracefully (e.g. `'?'` or omit) without throwing.
- The list-mode header renders `v<version>` right-aligned to `cols` (visible-width padding computed with ANSI codes stripped before padding), dimmed via `ANSI.dim`, matching the `[auto-refresh on]` treatment; the left-aligned `Work Items — N item(s)` title is unchanged.
- The version is read at runtime from the manifest, not hardcoded in the renderer (stays in sync with the manifest version).
- On narrow panes where the suffix would overlap the title, the suffix is dropped or truncated (guard on `cols`) — no layout breakage, no overflow beyond the pane width.
- Full project test suite passes with the new changes, including the header version tests (F1).

## Minimal Implementation
- Add a small version-read helper in `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` (or a sibling module) using the `readFileSync`/`dirname` pattern from `shortcut-config.ts`, with a safe fallback.
- In the list-mode header renderer (near line ~1585): compute the header's visible width, pad to `cols`, and append the dimmed `v<version>` suffix right-aligned; reuse `truncateLine`/visible-length logic; guard on `cols` for narrow panes.
- Keep the renderer testable via the existing `readFile`-style injection seam where practical.

## Dependencies
- Blocked by: header version rendering tests (F1) — test-first ordering.

## Deliverables
- Updated `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts`; version helper; no change to `packages/herdr/package.json` (version source only).
data.title: Implement version read + dimmed right-aligned header display

# Leaf-aware downtime dispatch (audit tier)

## Problem statement

The downtime worker requires ALL slots free (default `downtimeRequiredFreeSlots: 0`) before any dispatch, because a parent audit's Phase 2 fan-out (1 parent + up to 2 children) needs the whole pool. But most audit candidates are **leaf items** (no children) — their audit is a single Pi session needing **1 slot**. Requiring all slots free for a leaf audit wastes partial-idle capacity (e.g. 1 or 2 of 3 slots free) that could run it locally.

This is Q5 lever 2: make the audit tier check `wl show <id> --children --json` at selection time and require fewer free slots for leaf audits.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Audit-tier selection (`deps.getNextAuditCandidate` or `dispatchDowntimeWork`) fetches the candidate's children (`wl show <id> --children --json`; fail-closed → treat as parent, all-slots gate).
2. **Leaf candidate** (0 children): dispatch when at least 1 slot is free (`available_slots >= 1`) for the full idle threshold.
3. **Parent candidate** (>=1 children): unchanged — all slots free (with the bounded fan-out item, effectively 2 slots needed in cheap mode, 3 in fast).
4. Same-slot stability: the "same N slots free for the full threshold" guarantee requires per-slot identity — this item is BLOCKED BY LP-0MSORPUMX002LLIA (proxy exposes `slots: [{slot_id, is_processing}]` in `GET /llama/local/status`). Until it lands, leaf dispatch keeps the all-slots gate (no behavior change).
5. Optional (documented, not required): the race-accepting variant — dispatch on `available_slots >= 1` without per-slot identity, accepting that an interactive request may grab the slot and the audit's first call falls back to remote. Default OFF; fail-closed philosophy preserved.
6. Tests: leaf vs parent classification, children-query failure → parent gate, per-slot idle tracking integration (reuses WL-0MSG7P9N8009PCKG tracker), race-accepting variant toggle.
7. README documents the leaf/parent dispatch difference and the per-slot dependency.

## Dependencies

- **Blocked-by**: LP-0MSORPUMX002LLIA (proxy per-slot details, llm worklog) — same enabler as WL-0MSG7P9N8009PCKG.
- **Related**: WL-0MSORQ1RG005DGUS (bounded audit fan-out — makes parent audits fit the pool, complementary); WL-0MSG7P9N8009PCKG (same-slot idle tracker — the per-slot idle-duration machinery this item's gate consumes).
- **Related**: WL-0MSOMV6CW003OXTK (idle threshold 60s) — coordinate timing defaults.
data.title: Leaf-aware downtime dispatch: leaf audits dispatch on fewer free slots

## Decompose the `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` god module

**File:** `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` (2,798 lines, 37 exported symbols)

## Problem statement

`packages/herdr/src/index.ts` is the Herdr plugin entry point and has grown to
2,798 lines. It currently carries command routing, argument builders, background
dispatch, pane-ID capture, claim/priority resolution, interactive window and tab
placement, pane cleanup, dozens of production dependency resolvers, the
downtime-worker dependency factory, settings bootstrap and the full TUI
`main()` loop in one module. Navigating, reviewing and safely changing any one
concern requires holding the whole file in view, so every dispatch or TUI change
carries avoidable regression risk.

The 1,000-line maintainability ceiling was adopted for the parent refactor
series WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7. This item is the `index.ts` member of that sweep and
was created specifically to bring this file under the ceiling.

## Users

- **Herdr plugin maintainers (agents and humans)** need to change one concern
  (e.g. background dispatch, interactive placement, the TUI loop) without
  reasoning about 2,800 unrelated lines.
- **Reviewers/auditors** need a focused diff whose blast radius is legible from
  the touched module.
- **Future agents implementing plugin work items** need small, named modules
  they can locate with a file search instead of reading a monolith.

Example user stories:

- As an agent implementing a background-dispatch change, I want that path in a
  dedicated module so I can modify it without re-reading the TUI loop.
- As a reviewer, I want a split diff attributable to a single concern so I can
  verify it against its own tests.
- As a maintainer, I want each module under 1,000 lines so a file is readable in
  a single pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **No file exceeds 1,000 lines.** After the change, `wc -l` reports ≤1,000
   for `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` (now a thin barrel/entry module) and for
   every module created by the split.
2. **Public surface preserved — used symbols only.** Every symbol currently
   imported from `./index.js` by another module remains exported from that exact
   path with identical types and values, so `index.test.ts`, `claim.test.ts`,
   `fetchAuditItemById.test.ts` and `start.ts` compile with no import-path edits.
   The barrel re-exports **only symbols that are actually used** by consumers;
   unused exports stay internal to the extracted modules (inherited producer
   decision Q2 on the parent item, WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7).
3. **Entry-point behaviour preserved.** `start.ts` dynamically imports
   `./index.js` and calls `main()`; `index.ts` keeps exporting `main` and keeps
   the `isEntryPoint` guard so importing the module in a vitest worker still does
   not launch the TUI or call `process.exit`. The entry guard stays in the entry
   module (not in an extracted helper) so `process.argv[1]` identity checks keep
   their current meaning.
4. **Behaviour-preserving, move-only refactor.** No functional or logic change;
   no test file is modified (not its import paths, fixtures or assertions), and
   all `packages/herdr` test suites pass unchanged.
5. **Module-level singletons stay singular.** The `const settings =
   loadSettings()` side effect (currently line 2246) is evaluated **exactly once**
   at module load and shared by `createDowntimeDeps` and `main()`. It must not be
   duplicated into two modules, or the plugin would load settings twice with
   potentially different results. The same rule applies to the resolved script
   paths (`SEND_TO_PI_SCRIPT`, `RUN_IN_PANE_SCRIPT`) which depend on
   `import.meta.url` staying in `packages/herdr/src/`.
6. **No new circular imports.** Extracted modules import only from concrete
   sibling modules, never from the `index.js` barrel; the barrel imports downward
   only. The dependency check reports no new cycles (including the existing
   `stalled-work ↔ downtime-worker` type-only cycle, which must not be widened).
7. **Responsibility documented per module.** Each new module carries a
   module-level doc comment stating its single responsibility, and existing
   provenance comments (work-item ids, section banners) move with their code so
   traceability is preserved.
8. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
   comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
9. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes, and `npm run build`
   (tsc) must succeed — a module move that breaks the build is not a valid
   intermediate state.

## Constraints

- **Move-only.** Relocate code and update imports; do not refactor logic, rename
  public symbols, or change behaviour.
- **Barrel compatibility.** 3 test files and `start.ts` import from
  `./index.js`; the barrel preserves that contract (AC2/AC3).
- **Sequenced, tree-green landing.** Extract leaf modules first and work inwards,
  so each merged step leaves the build and the full suite green.
- **No new runtime dependencies**, no test-file rewrites, no changes to the wl
  CLI contract or to plugin behaviour.
- **Scope boundary.** This item targets `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` only. Test
  file size (`index.test.ts` is 3,977 lines), sibling production files and a
  repo-wide lint rule are out of scope (see Risks — scope creep).

## Existing state

`index.ts` is 2,798 lines. Its cohesive sections (line ranges from the current
`dev` checkout) are:

| # | Section | Lines | Size |
|---|---------|-------|------|
| 1 | Header, imports and resolved script paths | 1–174 | 174 |
| 2 | Command routing + arg builders (`routeCommand`, `stripCommandPrefix`, `buildSendToPiArgs`, `buildRunInPaneArgs`, `parsePaneIdFile`) | 176–376 | 201 |
| 3 | Background (no-pane) dispatch (`BACKGROUND_LOG_DIR`, log helpers, `spawnBackgroundShell`, `spawnBackgroundPi`) | 377–579 | 203 |
| 4 | Pane-ID capture + work-item extraction (`CAPTURE_*`, `capturePaneIdFromFile`, `extractWorkItemId`) | 580–675 | 96 |
| 5 | Claim + interactive priority (`claimItemForAgentCommand`, `resolveInteractiveDispatchPriority`, priority lookup, critical blockers) | 676–794 | 119 |
| 6 | Default anchor resolvers (dispatcher/project/tab/item, internal) | 795–895 | 101 |
| 7 | Interactive placement + root-pane cleanup (`resolveInteractiveWorkspaceId`, `resolveInteractiveItemAnchor`, `closeInteractiveTabRootPane`, `defaultInteractiveLiveTrackedPanesResolver`, `defaultInteractiveClosePane`) | 896–1111 | 216 |
| 8 | Downtime/stalled resolvers (`defaultRunningDowntimePanesResolver`, `defaultStalledResume*`, `defaultStalledPanesLister`, `worklogRootFromPiSessionPath`, `defaultStalledPaneRootResolver`, `readClosedPaneIds`) | 1112–1319 | 208 |
| 9 | `createDowntimeDeps` dependency factory | 1323–2244 | 922 |
| 10 | Settings bootstrap (`const settings = loadSettings()`) | 2246 | 1 |
| 11 | Worklog target configuration (`configureWorklogTarget`, `uninitializedReport`) | 2261–2283 | 23 |
| 12 | TUI `main()` loop | 2284–2783 | 500 |
| 13 | Entry-point guard (`isEntryPoint` + `main().catch`) | 2785–2798 | 14 |

Relevant structural facts discovered during intake:

- **Used public surface (26 symbols):** static imports from `./index.js` are
  `stripCommandPrefix`, `routeCommand`, `stripAgentPromptPrefix`,
  `buildSendToPiArgs`, `buildRunInPaneArgs`, `createDowntimeDeps`,
  `capturePaneIdFromFile`, `parsePaneIdFile`, `buildBackgroundLogPath`,
  `spawnBackgroundShell`, `spawnBackgroundPi`, `formatBackgroundFailure`,
  `CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `extractWorkItemId`, `defaultStalledPaneRootResolver`,
  `defaultStalledPanesLister`, `worklogRootFromPiSessionPath`,
  `resolveInteractiveDispatchPriority`, `claimItemForAgentCommand`; dynamic
  `import('./index.js')` in `index.test.ts` additionally uses
  `configureWorklogTarget`, `uninitializedReport`,
  `defaultInteractiveLiveTrackedPanesResolver`, `resolveInteractiveWorkspaceId`,
  `resolveInteractiveItemAnchor`, `closeInteractiveTabRootPane`; `start.ts`
  dynamically uses `main`.
- **Unused exported symbols (safe to keep internal):** `CommandRoute`,
  `BACKGROUND_LOG_DIR`, `BackgroundSpawnDeps`, `CAPTURE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`,
  `PaneIdFileDeps`, `InteractiveLiveTrackedPanesResult`,
  `InteractiveRootPaneCleanupDeps`, `defaultInteractiveClosePane`,
  `defaultRunningDowntimePanesResolver`, `defaultStalledResumePromptAgent`,
  `defaultStalledResumeStartAgent`.
- **Single module-level side effect:** `const settings = loadSettings()` at line
  2246, read by `createDowntimeDeps` (line 2144) and `main()`. No other top-level
  statements exist beyond the entry guard.
- **Entry point chain:** `herdr-plugin.toml` launches
  `npx tsx src/start.ts`; `start.ts` dynamically imports `./index.js` and calls
  `main()`. The `isEntryPoint` guard in both modules prevents test-time launch.
- **Test gate:** `index.test.ts` (3,977 lines), `claim.test.ts` (407), and
  `fetchAuditItemById.test.ts` (281) import the module and must stay unmodified.
- **Precedent:** WL-0MQJK4UJD0028IRO decomposed the 2,584-line
  `src/database.ts` god class under ACs requiring an unchanged public API,
  tests passing without modification, and per-module line ceilings.
- **Parent decisions inherited:** scope limited to this file with follow-up items
  for the rest (Q1 → A); keep a public barrel re-exporting used symbols only
  (Q2 → A refined); delivery as an epic decomposed into sequenced child items,
  leaf-first (Q3 → A). See WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 Appendix.

## Desired change

Reduce `index.ts` to a thin re-export barrel plus the entry-point guard and
shared bootstrap side effect, and move its contents into cohesive sibling
modules. A starting decomposition (boundaries are an implementation decision,
subject to the constraints above):

| New module | Responsibility | Approx. size |
|---|---|---|
| `index.commands.ts` | `routeCommand`, `stripCommandPrefix`, `buildSendToPiArgs`, `buildRunInPaneArgs`, `parsePaneIdFile` and command-prefix helpers | ~210 |
| `index.background.ts` | Background (no-pane) dispatch: log paths, failure formatting, `spawnBackgroundShell`, `spawnBackgroundPi` | ~205 |
| `index.pane-capture.ts` | `capturePaneIdFromFile`, capture constants, `extractWorkItemId` | ~100 |
| `index.claim.ts` | `claimItemForAgentCommand`, interactive dispatch priority and critical-blocker lookup | ~120 |
| `index.interactive.ts` | Interactive workspace/item anchor resolution, tab root-pane cleanup and live-tracked-pane resolvers | ~220 |
| `index.resolvers.ts` | Production default resolvers for dispatcher/project/item anchors, running downtime panes, stalled panes and worklog root | ~310 |
| `index.downtime-deps.ts` | `createDowntimeDeps` and its internal helpers (includes the `fetchAuditItemById` closure) | ~925 |
| `index.settings.ts` | Single `settings = loadSettings()` instance and `configureWorklogTarget`/`uninitializedReport` bootstrap helpers | ~30 |
| `index.main.ts` | The TUI `main()` loop | ~505 |
| `index.ts` | Thin barrel re-exporting used symbols + entry-point guard | ~120–200 |

If any candidate module still exceeds the ceiling, it is split further along the
section boundary rather than left oversized. `createDowntimeDeps` is the largest
single unit (922 lines) and may need its `fetchAuditItemById` closure extracted to
stay clearly under the limit.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` — reduce to a thin barrel + entry-point guard; preserve every used export.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.commands.ts` — new; command routing and argument builders.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.background.ts` — new; background dispatch and log handling.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.pane-capture.ts` — new; pane-ID capture and work-item extraction.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.claim.ts` — new; claim and interactive priority.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.interactive.ts` — new; interactive placement and pane cleanup.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.resolvers.ts` — new; default dependency resolvers.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.downtime-deps.ts` — new; `createDowntimeDeps` factory.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.settings.ts` — new; single settings instance and bootstrap helpers.
- `packages/herdr/src/index.main.ts` — new; TUI `main()` loop.
- `packages/herdr/src/start.ts`, `index.test.ts`, `claim.test.ts`, `fetchAuditItemById.test.ts` — must remain unmodified; they are the behaviour-preservation gate.
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — module-layout note pointing at the new files.
- `docs/dev/herdr-hydrator.md` — update the `index.ts` production-wiring reference if paths move.
- `docs/dev/rca-downtime-3-consecutive-wl-cli-errors.md` — update the `createDowntimeDeps` file reference if it moves.

## Related work

- **WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7** — *downtime-worker.ts is a god class* (parent refactor series; discovered-from). Source of the 1,000-line sweep and the producer's Q1–Q3 decisions.
- **WL-0MQJK4UJD0028IRO** — *Decompose WorklogDatabase god class (src/database.ts, 2,584 lines)* (completed). Direct precedent: same refactor shape, same AC pattern.
- **WL-0MQRVM54T006WQ20** — *Fix piman.ts extension path after index.ts removal* (completed). Prior change to this entry point's path resolution.
- **WL-0MQRU076X0050VNB** — *Fix duplicate extension load caused by re-export shim* (completed). Relevant caution: a re-export shim previously caused a duplicate extension load.
- **WL-0MVGKGD2Y0038S6B** — *Refactor: decompose packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts god class* (in progress). Sibling refactor item.
- **WL-0MT2GITCX009WUEW** — *Remove packages/herdr/src/icons.ts and rewire herdr consumers* (completed). Related herdr consumer-rewiring precedent.
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — herdr package overview; documents the entry point.
- `docs/dev/herdr-hydrator.md` — describes the production wiring in `index.ts`.
- `docs/dev/rca-downtime-3-consecutive-wl-cli-errors.md` — references `createDowntimeDeps` in `index.ts`.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MT2GITCX009WUEW** – Remove packages/herdr/src/icons.ts and rewire herdr consumers (completed)
- **WL-0MSNULGSM00018I4** – herdr plugin crashes at startup: Cannot find package 'marked' (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) (completed)
- **WL-0MVGKGMU400631VZ** – Refactor: decompose src/sync.ts god class (goal: no file > 1000 lines) (open)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md`
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`
- `CLI.md`

## Risks and assumptions

- **Barrel-induced runtime cycle (medium).** A module that imports from
  `index.js` would create a cycle through the barrel. *Mitigation:* extracted
  modules import only concrete siblings; the barrel imports downward only
  (AC6).
- **Duplicate settings load (medium).** `const settings = loadSettings()` must
  live in exactly one module. *Mitigation:* AC5; keep it in a leaf
  `index.settings.ts` consumed by both `createDowntimeDeps` and `main()`.
- **Broken entry point (high).** `start.ts` imports `main()` and the
  `isEntryPoint` guard depends on `process.argv[1]`. *Mitigation:* AC3 keeps
  `main` and the guard in `index.ts`; the plugin-startup tests and
  `vitest run` on `index.test.ts` are the gate.
- **Lost provenance / accidental logic drift (medium).** A large move invites
  silent edits. *Mitigation:* move-only rule, unchanged test suite (AC4), and a
  review pass that diffs moved blocks against the original.
- **Test-file temptation (low).** Updating `index.test.ts` import paths is the
  easy path but erases the behaviour-preservation signal. *Mitigation:* AC2/AC4
  make unchanged tests a hard gate.
- **`index.test.ts` is also over 1,000 lines (1,977 lines over).** It is
  explicitly out of scope here (test files were evaluated in lockstep with their
  module, not filed as standalone items). Recorded as a known follow-up
  opportunity, not absorbed into this item. *Mitigation:* note it in the plan
  and, if the producer wants it, file a separate test-decomposition item.
- **Scope-creep risk (explicit).** Splitting sibling files, adding a lint rule
  for file length, or refactoring behaviour are out of scope; each is recorded
  as a linked follow-up rather than absorbed here.

## Assumptions

- Each sequenced child lands tree-green: `npm run build` succeeds and the full
  suite passes before the next child starts.
- The decomposition will be delivered as an epic with sequenced child items (one
  per extracted module), landed leaf-first and independently green (parent Q3).
- The barrel re-exports only the symbols consumers use; unused exports become
  internal (parent Q2).
- `index.test.ts`, `claim.test.ts`, `fetchAuditItemById.test.ts` and `start.ts`
  remain unmodified.
- The `createDowntimeDeps` closure `fetchAuditItemById` may need extraction to
  keep its module under the ceiling; that is an implementation decision, not a
  behaviour change.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

**Inherited from the parent item (WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7) — no new questions
blocking:**

- Q (scope): Is the "no file > 1,000 lines" goal limited to this file, or should
  other `packages/herdr` files be split too? — **Answer (producer, 2026-10-20):
  A** — limit to this file; follow-up items for the rest; add the >1,000-line
  check to the refactor skill. Source: parent Appendix Q1.
- Q (compatibility): Keep a public barrel re-exporting the current surface, or
  update importers? — **Answer (producer, 2026-10-20): A, refined** — keep the
  barrel, but re-export only symbols actually used. Source: parent Appendix Q2.
- Q (delivery shape): One big-bang change or an epic with sequenced children? —
  **Answer (producer, 2026-10-20): A** — epic with sequenced children, leaf
  modules first, blocking order. Source: parent Appendix Q3.

**Resolved by repository inspection (no producer answer required):**

- Q: How large is the file and what are its cohesive sections? — Answer: 2,798
  lines across 13 logical sections (inventory above). Source: `wc -l` and export
  scan of `packages/herdr/src/index.ts`.
- Q: How many consumers depend on its public surface? — Answer: 3 test files
  (`index.test.ts`, `claim.test.ts`, `fetchAuditItemById.test.ts`) and
  `start.ts`; 26 symbols are actually used. Source: import scan of
  `packages/herdr/src/*.ts`.
- Q: Is there module-level mutable state that a split could duplicate? — Answer:
  yes, `const settings = loadSettings()` (line 2246), read by
  `createDowntimeDeps` and `main()`. Source: line scan of the file.
- Q: What is the entry-point contract? — Answer: `herdr-plugin.toml` launches
  `src/start.ts`, which dynamically imports `./index.js` and calls `main()`; an
  `isEntryPoint` guard prevents test-time launch. Source:
  `packages/herdr/herdr-plugin.toml`, `packages/herdr/src/start.ts`,
  `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` (line 2785).
- Q: Is there an existing import cycle to preserve carefully? — Answer: a
  type-only `stalled-work ↔ downtime-worker` cycle exists at the package level;
  this split must not widen it. Source: imports in both files (inherited
  parent finding).

# Refactor: decompose `packages/shared/src/database.ts` god class

## Problem statement

`packages/shared/src/database.ts` is 3,684 lines and holds a single
`WorklogDatabase` class with 109 methods spanning at least ten unrelated
concerns (work-item CRUD, hierarchy traversal, dependency-edge reconciliation,
comment storage, audit results, FTS/semantic search, sort-index management, the
`wl next` selection pipeline, JSONL import/export, and Git/JSONL sync). It
breaches the 1,000-line maintainability ceiling adopted for
WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 and is hard to navigate, review, and change safely.

## Users

- **Agents implementing work items** — need to locate the code for one concern
  without reading 3,684 lines; large files inflate context cost and increase
  the chance of editing the wrong overload.
- **Reviewers / producers auditing changes** — need diffs scoped to one
  responsibility; a 3,684-line file makes review of a 20-line behavioural
  change impractical.
- **Operators debugging `wl next`** — need the selection pipeline (the largest
  cluster: ~1,150 lines) to be readable in isolation.

Example user stories:

- As an agent, I want `wl next` selection logic in its own module, so that a
  change to selection ordering does not require loading CRUD, sync and comment
  code into context.
- As a reviewer, I want each extracted module to have a single stated
  responsibility, so that I can judge a diff against one boundary.
- As a maintainer, I want the public `WorklogDatabase` API unchanged, so that
  no CLI/Herdr/TUI consumer needs touching.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Ceiling met.** `packages/shared/src/database.ts` and every file under
   `packages/shared/src/database/` is ≤ 1,000 lines (target: largest extracted
   module ≤ 700). Verified with `wc -l` output recorded in the work item.
2. **Public API unchanged.** `WorklogDatabase` (all public method signatures and
   constructor), plus `WorklogDatabaseServices`, `JsonlImportResult`,
   `GitTarget`, `UpdateIfMatchesResult` and `normalizeTitleForMatch` remain
   importable from the unchanged specifier `@worklog/shared` (entry
   `dist/database.js`). No changes to `src/**` or `packages/herdr/src/**`
   consumer code.
3. **Move-only, behaviour-preserving.** No logic, SQL, error-message, ordering,
   or schema changes; existing test assertions are unmodified and the suite is
   green. Test files may be split/moved only where a test file itself exceeds
   1,000 lines (lockstep rule), with import paths the only mechanical change.
4. **No circular imports.** The extracted-module import graph is acyclic; no
   module imports the `database.ts` façade. Shared types live in a context
   module that every extracted module may import.
5. **Responsibilities documented.** `packages/shared/README.md` (Package
   Structure) and each new module's header comment state its single
   responsibility and its boundary.
6. **No performance regression** in the `wl next` path: `npm run
   benchmark:wl-next:json` pre/post comparison within run-to-run noise (the
   extraction moves code only, and `EdgeCache`/effective-priority caching
   semantics are unchanged).
7. **Builds and tests.** `npm run build:shared`, `npm run build` and the full
   project test suite all pass.
8. **Documentation updated.** All related documentation reflects the changes,
   including code comments, `packages/shared/README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`,
   `docs/dev/fts.md`, `docs/dependency-reconciliation.md` and
   `docs/design/incremental-sync.md` (each currently names
   `packages/shared/src/database.ts` as the home of a concern).

## Constraints

- **Move-only.** Extraction and method relocation only; no "while we're here"
  rewrites. Method-level decomposition of the two oversized methods
  (`handleCriticalEscalation`, 324 lines; `findNextWorkItemFromItems`, 251
  lines) is allowed **only** where required to keep an extracted file under the
  ceiling, and must land as a separate commit from the pure move.
- **No public-API growth.** Private hooks needed by extracted modules are
  expressed through an internal context type, not by making `WorklogDatabase`
  members public.
- **Icons import guard (WL-0MT2GMTAZ003VKVL).** `tests/unit/icons.test.ts`
  scans every `.ts`/`.js` file with `ICONS_FILE_RE` and fails on any relative
  `icons.js`/`icons.ts` import. Extracted modules must keep using
  `@worklog/shared/icons`.
- **`src/database.ts` (93-line CLI shim) is unchanged.**
- **No new runtime dependencies.**
- **Serialize with WL-0MVGKGJXJ000ISBU** (`packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts`,
  2,225 lines) — same package and build; running both decompositions
  concurrently would churn `packages/shared/dist` and invite merge conflicts.
- **Escaped backticks** only in written content; Markdown otherwise.

## Existing state

- `packages/shared/src/database.ts` — 3,684 lines, 6 exports: the
  `WorklogDatabase` class (109 methods), `normalizeTitleForMatch`, and four
  interfaces (`JsonlImportResult`, `GitTarget`, `UpdateIfMatchesResult`,
  `WorklogDatabaseServices`).
- Entry point: `packages/shared/package.json` → `main`/`exports["."]` =
  `./dist/database.js`; `src/database.ts` (root, 93 lines) is a thin CLI
  shim wiring CLI-specific services and re-exporting the shared class.
- Consumers: ~54 files reference the class (`src/**`, `packages/herdr/src/**`,
  `tests/**`, `scripts/**`, `bench/**`), all via `@worklog/shared` or the
  shim — none import internal members.
- Tests in lockstep: `packages/shared/src/database.test.ts` (834),
  `database-dedup.test.ts` (134), `dirty-tracking.test.ts` (384),
  `audit-fingerprint-repair.test.ts` (135) — all under 1,000; plus root
  `tests/database.test.ts` (3,651) and `tests/next-regression.test.ts`
  (2,112), which exceed the ceiling and are therefore in scope for
  lockstep splitting.
- **Prior attempt did not land.** WL-0MQJK4UJD0028IRO ("Decompose
  WorklogDatabase god class", completed) extracted `src/lib/edge-cache.ts` and
  `src/lib/audit-store.ts` on the feature branch only — neither file exists in
  the current tree, and the class has since grown from 2,584 to 3,684 lines.
  This item therefore restarts from a single-class module, and the regrowth is
  the reason the decomposition needs a clear ownership boundary rather than
  ad-hoc extraction.

## Desired change

Extract cohesive modules under `packages/shared/src/database/`, leaving
`database.ts` as a façade that constructs the collaborators and delegates.
Proposed map (method attribution is exhaustive; every current method belongs to
exactly one row):

| Module | Responsibility | Est. lines |
|---|---|---|
| `database.ts` (façade) | Construction/service wiring, delegation, `close()`, existing barrel re-exports | ~400 |
| `database/context.ts` | Shared internal types (`EdgeCache`, database context/hooks), `buildChildrenByParent`, `laterTimestamp`, id generation and prefix accessors, `normalizeTitleForMatch` | ~290 |
| `database/work-items.ts` | Item CRUD (`create`, `createWithNextSortIndex`, `get`, `update`, `updateIfMatches`, `delete`, `list`, duplicate detection, diff helpers) | ~470 |
| `database/hierarchy.ts` | Children/descendants/depth/leaf queries, `cascadePriorityDowngrade`, `demoteParentOnChildAdded`, `revertToPlanComplete` | ~200 |
| `database/dependencies.ts` | Edge CRUD, `buildEdgeCache`, blocker queries, dependency-status reconciliation | ~260 |
| `database/comments.ts` | Comment CRUD, `upsertComments`/`importComments`, activity stamping | ~180 |
| `database/audit.ts` | Audit-result CRUD, waiver set/clear, invalidation reconcile, audit map + not-ready freshness | ~130 |
| `database/sort.ts` | `sortItemsByScore`, sort-index compute/assign/preview, `reSort`, `orderBySortIndex`, audit-tier comparison, `selectBySortIndex` | ~310 |
| `database/priority.ts` | `getPriorityValue`, `riskOrdinal`, `effortOrdinal`, `matchesRiskEffort`, `computeEffectivePriority` | ~200 |
| `database/next-pipeline.ts` | `findNextWorkItem`/`findNextWorkItems`/`findNextWorkItemFromItems`, `applyFilters`, `filterCandidates`, `resolveBlockerToRoot`, `selectHighestPriorityBlocking` | ~600 |
| `database/critical-escalation.ts` | `handleCriticalEscalation` and its private helpers (may require an internal split to stay under budget) | ~330 |
| `database/search.ts` | `search`, `rebuildFtsIndex`, semantic-index create/trigger/remove | ~210 |
| `database/sync.ts` | `refreshFromGit`, `exportForSync`, export timestamps, `countDirtyRecords`, delta metadata, `deleteLocalJsonl`, `refreshFromJsonlIfNewer`, auto-sync triggers | ~380 |
| `database/import-export.ts` | `import`, `upsertItems`, `clear`, `getAll*` snapshots | ~200 |

Dependency direction after extraction:
`database.ts` → {any module}; modules → `context.ts` + `../types.js` +
`../persistent-store.js` + `@worklog/shared/icons`. No module → `database.ts`.

### Proposed child decomposition (structural slices)

1. **Foundation** — create `database/` and `database/context.ts` (internal
   types, EdgeCache, children map, id generation, prefix accessors). Blocks the
   rest.
2. **`wl next` cluster** — `priority.ts`, `next-pipeline.ts`,
   `critical-escalation.ts` (largest win, highest risk).
3. **Ordering & audit** — `sort.ts`, `audit.ts`.
4. **Items & hierarchy** — `work-items.ts`, `hierarchy.ts`.
5. **Dependencies & comments** — `dependencies.ts`, `comments.ts`.
6. **Search, sync & import/export + closeout** — `search.ts`, `sync.ts`,
   `import-export.ts`, oversized test-file splits, docs/README, final `wc -l`
   evidence, build and full suite.

Slices are ordered so that slice 1 blocks the rest; each slice is move-only and
independently verifiable.

## Key Files

- `packages/shared/src/database.ts` — façade after extraction; public API must
  stay byte-compatible at the type level
- `packages/shared/src/database/*.ts` — new cohesive modules (map above)
- `packages/shared/src/database.test.ts`, `database-dedup.test.ts`,
  `dirty-tracking.test.ts`, `audit-fingerprint-repair.test.ts` — imports stay
  `./database.js`; assertions unchanged
- `tests/database.test.ts` (3,651) — split in lockstep, move-only
- `tests/next-regression.test.ts` (2,112) — split in lockstep, move-only
- `packages/shared/README.md` — Package Structure section
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/dev/fts.md`,
  `docs/dependency-reconciliation.md`, `docs/design/incremental-sync.md` —
  update file references to the new module paths
- `bench/wl-next-perf.ts` — pre/post performance evidence (no change expected)

## Risks & assumptions

- **Behaviour drift in the `wl next` pipeline** (largest, most intricate
  cluster; 324- and 251-line methods). *Mitigation:* pure move first; split
  oversized methods in separate commits; `tests/next-regression.test.ts`
  and `docs/validation/status-stage-inventory.md` act as the behaviour oracle.
- **Circular imports** (`next-pipeline` ↔ `dependencies` ↔ `priority`).
  *Mitigation:* `context.ts` owns shared types; modules receive collaborators
  through the context; façade is never imported by a module.
- **Hidden `this.` coupling.** Several "private" helpers are shared across
  concerns (`buildEdgeCache`, `generateId`, `buildAuditMapForItems`,
  `compareTrackedFields`, `getPriorityValue`, `getNonClosedChildren`,
  `debug`). *Mitigation:* inventory every `this.` call per method before the
  move and express it on the context type.
- **Build/packaging regression.** `packages/shared` `main`/`exports` point at
  `dist/database.js`; the façade must keep that path and re-export every type.
- **Performance regression** through changed cache lifetimes. *Mitigation:*
  `npm run benchmark:wl-next:json` before and after the `wl next` cluster.
- **Regrowth repeats** (this file grew 2,584 → 3,684 after a "completed"
  decomposition). *Mitigation within scope:* documented module boundaries and
  single-responsibility headers. A repo-wide file-size guard is **out of
  scope** here and filed separately (see Related work) to avoid scope creep.
- **Merge contention** with WL-0MVGKGJXJ000ISBU (`packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts`).
  *Mitigation:* serialise the two items; do not run both concurrently.
- **Assumption:** the 1,000-line ceiling applies to non-test source, and to
  test files only when they are touched in lockstep with their module.
- **Assumption:** no consumer call-site changes are acceptable, including in
  `scripts/` and `bench/`.
- **Assumption:** no behavioural improvement is bundled in; any improvement
  observed en route becomes a separate `discovered-from` work item.

## Related work

- WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 — parent sweep: every production file > 1,000 lines is
  evaluated for decomposition (producer directive, Q1 answered).
- WL-0MQJK4UJD0028IRO — prior "Decompose WorklogDatabase god class"
  (completed, but the extracted `src/lib/edge-cache.ts` /
  `src/lib/audit-store.ts` never landed on `main`; informs the
  `context.ts` + `audit.ts` boundaries proposed here).
- WL-0MQPQOFVX003V32B — Phase 1: extracted `WorklogDatabase` into
  `packages/shared/` (explains the `src/database.ts` shim split).
- WL-0MV85WFYU0071YQ9 — removed `needsProducerReview` from the worklog core
  (recent material change inside this file).
- WL-0MVGKGJXJ000ISBU — sibling: decompose
  `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` (same package; serialise).
- WL-0MVGKGD2Y0038S6B, WL-0MVGKGFFN009UCM6, WL-0MVGKGMU400631VZ — companion
  god-class items from the same sweep.
- Repo docs that name this file as a home of a concern: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
  (§ sort ordering, § database init), `docs/dev/fts.md` (`search()`),
  `docs/dependency-reconciliation.md` (§ reconciliation logic),
  `docs/design/incremental-sync.md` (`exportForSync()`),
  `docs/validation/status-stage-inventory.md`
  (`findNextWorkItemFromItems`).
- Discovered during intake: repo-wide file-size guard (created separately,
  `discovered-from:WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT`).

## Appendix: decision log (agent-proposed; producer may override)

No producer interview questions were required: the seed context (goal, drafted
ACs, parent directive) is sufficient to draft an actionable brief, and every
remaining choice is a reversible design decision that the plan/implement stages
can adjust. The three decisions below were taken by the agent and are recorded
for review.

- **Q: How should extracted modules relate to `WorklogDatabase`?**
  **Recommended and chosen: (a)** pure functional modules operating on an
  injected internal context type, with `WorklogDatabase` as a delegating
  façade. Rationale: testable without a database, no inheritance/mixin
  complexity, and the import graph stays acyclic (the façade depends on the
  modules, never the reverse).
  Alternatives considered: (b) composed private helper classes instantiated by
  the façade (more state plumbing, harder to test in isolation); (c) mixins /
  `extends` chains (fragile, obscures the public surface).

- **Q: What child granularity?**
  **Recommended and chosen:** six children (foundation; `wl next` cluster;
  ordering & audit; items & hierarchy; dependencies & comments; search, sync &
  import/export + closeout). Rationale: each child is independently move-only,
  verifiable with the full suite, and small enough to review; the riskiest
  cluster (`wl next`) is isolated so a regression is bisectable.
  Alternatives considered: ~13 children (one per module — more overhead and
  churn than value); one child (no bisectable checkpoints).

- **Q: Add a file-size regression guard (CI/lint) in this item?**
  **Recommended and chosen: no — out of scope.** A guard is repo-wide policy
  affecting every sibling god-class item, not a property of this file.
  Filed as a separate low-priority `chore` item (`discovered-from` this item).

- **Q: Should the oversized test files (`tests/database.test.ts` 3,651;
  `tests/next-regression.test.ts` 2,112) be split?**
  **Recommended and chosen: yes, mechanical split only**, in lockstep with the
  module extraction, because the parent sweep rule evaluates test files in
  lockstep with their module. Assertions, `describe` titles and fixture
  helpers are unchanged; only file location/imports move.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MQPQOFVX003V32B** – Phase 1 — Extract WorklogDatabase into packages/shared/ (completed)
- **WL-0MTFNIXM3000NFVC** – Attribute real deletes: shared delete + CLI/API wiring (completed)
- **WL-0MT2GITCX009WUEW** – Remove packages/herdr/src/icons.ts and rewire herdr consumers (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — matched: acceptable, acceptance, act, actionable, activity (+359 more)
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — matched: act, activity, add, ade, adopted (+337 more)
- `CLI.md` — matched: act, actionable, activity, add, ade (+325 more)

# Refactor: decompose `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` god class

## Problem statement

`packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` is 2,340 lines and holds a single
`SqlitePersistentStore` class spanning at least eight unrelated concerns
(connection open/read-only handling, schema DDL and additive repair, metadata
and delta-sync watermarks, work-item CRUD with hierarchy ordering, comment
CRUD, dependency-edge CRUD, audit-result CRUD, FTS5 index/search, and an
in-memory query cache). It breaches the 1,000-line maintainability ceiling
adopted for WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 and is hard to navigate, review and change
safely.

## Users

- **Agents implementing work items** — need to locate one concern (e.g. the FTS
  search path) without loading 2,340 unrelated lines into context.
- **Reviewers / producers auditing changes** — need a diff whose blast radius
  is legible from the touched module.
- **Operators / maintainers debugging storage behaviour** — need the read-only
  open contract, cache invalidation rules and FTS fallback readable in
  isolation.

Example user stories:

- As an agent, I want the FTS search/fallback logic in its own module, so that
  a change to ranking does not require reading schema, audit and comment code.
- As a reviewer, I want each extracted module to declare a single
  responsibility, so that I can judge a diff against one boundary.
- As a maintainer, I want `SqlitePersistentStore`'s public surface unchanged, so
  that `packages/shared/src/database.ts` and the benchmark consumers need no
  edits.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Ceiling met.** `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` and every file
   under `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/` is ≤ 1,000 lines (target:
   largest extracted module ≤ 600). Verified with pre/post `wc -l` output
   recorded on the work item.
2. **Public surface preserved.** `SqlitePersistentStore`,
   `PersistentStoreServices`, `PersistentStoreCacheOptions`,
   `PersistentStoreOpenOptions`, `FtsSearchResult`, `LastExportTimestamps`,
   `MigrationInfo`, `normalizeSqliteValue`, `normalizeSqliteBindings`,
   `unescapeText` and `parseAuditWaiver` remain importable from the unchanged
   specifiers `./persistent-store.js` (package build `dist/persistent-store.js`)
   with identical types and behaviour. Consumers —
   `packages/shared/src/database.ts` and `scripts/benchmark-caching.ts` — need
   no import-path edits.
3. **Move-only, behaviour-preserving.** No logic, SQL, ordering, error-message,
   schema, cache-semantics or public-signature change. No existing test file is
   modified (import paths, fixtures or assertions); all
   `packages/shared/src/*.test.ts` suites and the full project suite pass
   unchanged.
4. **No circular imports.** The extracted-module import graph is acyclic; no
   module imports the `persistent-store.ts` façade. Shared internal state
   (`db` handle, cache, SQL-binding helpers, row mappers) is reached through an
   internal context type, not by modules importing the façade.
5. **Responsibilities documented.** Each new module carries a header comment
   stating its single responsibility; `packages/shared/README.md` (Package
   Structure) lists the new layout.
6. **Builds and tests.** `npm run build:shared`, `npm run build` and the full
   project test suite pass (run through the test skill, not ad-hoc commands).
7. **Documentation updated.** All related documentation reflects the changes,
   including code comments, `packages/shared/README.md`, `docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md`,
   `docs/design/incremental-sync.md`, `docs/dev/sync-persist-performance.md` and
   `docs/dev/wal-checkpointing-investigation.md` where they name this file as the
   home of a concern.

## Constraints

- **Move-only.** Extraction and relocation only; no "while we're here"
  rewrites. Method-level decomposition of any oversized method is allowed only
  where required to keep an extracted file under the ceiling, and lands as a
  separate commit from the pure move.
- **Barrel compatibility.** `persistent-store.ts` stays as the public entry,
  re-exporting the full current export set (11 symbols). It is not in the
  package `exports` map, but `packages/shared/src/database.ts` and
  `scripts/benchmark-caching.ts` (`dist/persistent-store.js`) resolve it by
  path, so the file must remain.
- **Package layout.** New modules live under
  `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/`, mirroring the `src/database/`
  layout agreed for the sibling epic WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT. `tsconfig` already
  includes `src/**/*`, so no build-config change is required.
- **Serialise with WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT** (`packages/shared/src/database.ts`) —
  same package and build; running both decompositions concurrently would churn
  `packages/shared/dist` and invite merge conflicts. Do not run both at once.
- **Scope boundary.** Only `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts`. The root
  sibling `src/persistent-store.ts` (1,653 lines) has its own item
  (WL-0MVGKGU19004NTHB) and is **out of scope**; the two files are divergent
  forks (the shared copy adds read-only open, audit-waiver parsing, the query
  cache and delta-sync watermarks), so no cross-file unification is attempted
  here.
- **No new runtime dependencies.** No changes to the wl CLI contract, storage
  schema, or the `@worklog/shared` package `exports` map.
- **Escaped backticks** only in written content; Markdown otherwise.

## Existing state

- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` — 2,340 lines, 11 exports.
- Consumers (all resolve the same barrel path): `packages/shared/src/database.ts`
  imports `SqlitePersistentStore`, `FtsSearchResult`,
  `PersistentStoreServices`, `PersistentStoreCacheOptions`,
  `LastExportTimestamps`, `unescapeText`;
  `scripts/benchmark-caching.ts` dynamically imports
  `dist/persistent-store.js` for `SqlitePersistentStore`. No other source file
  imports the module directly.
- In-lockstep tests: `packages/shared/src/database.test.ts` (839),
  `dirty-tracking.test.ts` (384), `database-dedup.test.ts` (134),
  `audit-fingerprint-repair.test.ts` (135), `database-readonly.test.ts` (185)
  — all under 1,000 and exercise `SqlitePersistentStore` through
  `WorklogDatabase`. No test file needs splitting.
- Current section inventory (from the `dev` checkout):

| Section | Lines | Size |
|---|---|---|
| Module doc, interfaces, SQL-binding/waiver utilities | 1–258 | 258 |
| Constructor, connection open, read-only handling, schema init/repair | 259–594 | 336 |
| Metadata, last-export timestamps, delta-sync metadata | 595–705 | 111 |
| Work-item CRUD, sort-index and hierarchy ordering | 706–1186 | 481 |
| Comment CRUD | 1187–1287 | 101 |
| Dependency edges, `importData`, transactions | 1288–1449 | 162 |
| Audit results (`saveAuditResult`, `reconcileAuditInvalidation`, CRUD) | 1450–1667 | 218 |
| FTS5 index, `searchFts`, `searchFallback`, `findByIdSubstring` | 1668–2137 | 470 |
| In-memory cache helpers and invalidation | 2138–2230 | 93 |
| `close()` and row mappers (`rowToWorkItem`/`rowToComment`/`rowToDependencyEdge`) | 2231–2340 | 110 |

- **Sibling duplication relationship (investigated).** `src/persistent-store.ts`
  (1,653 lines) is an older fork of the same class: it lacks the shared copy's
  read-only open mode (`PersistentStoreOpenOptions`), `auditWaiver` column and
  `parseAuditWaiver`, the in-memory query cache (`PersistentStoreCacheOptions`),
  delta-sync watermarks (`LastExportTimestamps`,
  `getDeltaSyncMetadata`/`setDeltaSyncMetadata`) and
  `reconcileAuditInvalidation`. They are not interchangeable; leave both in
  place and refactor each under its own item.
- **Prior related attempt.** WL-0MQJK4UF0002OKUD ("Extract concerns from
  `SqlitePersistentStore`") touched the **root** `src/persistent-store.ts` on a
  feature branch only — none of its extracted modules
  (`src/lib/sql-bindings.ts`, `src/lib/fts-search.ts`,
  `src/lib/schema-manager.ts`) exist in the current tree. It is precedent for
  the decomposition shape, not a completed change to this file.
- **Precedent (same package).** WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT (in progress,
  `intake_complete`) decomposes `packages/shared/src/database.ts` (3,684 lines)
  into `packages/shared/src/database/*` behind an unchanged façade; this item
  follows the same layout and AC pattern and must be serialised with it.

## Desired change

Reduce `persistent-store.ts` to a thin façade/barrel that constructs the
collaborators and delegates, moving the method bodies into cohesive siblings
under `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/`. A starting map (boundaries are an
implementation decision, subject to the constraints above; every current method
belongs to exactly one row):

| Module | Responsibility | Est. lines |
|---|---|---|
| `persistent-store.ts` (façade) | Constructor, connection open (incl. read-only), `close()`, `ftsAvailable`/`readOnly` getters, delegation, barrel re-exports | ~300 |
| `persistent-store/types.ts` | `MigrationInfo`, `PersistentStoreServices`, `FtsSearchResult`, `PersistentStoreOpenOptions`, `LastExportTimestamps`, `PersistentStoreCacheOptions`, `DbMetadata`, `RequiredColumn`, `CacheEntry` | ~190 |
| `persistent-store/sql-bindings.ts` | `normalizeSqliteValue`, `normalizeSqliteBindings`, `unescapeText`, `parseAuditWaiver` | ~75 |
| `persistent-store/schema.ts` | `SCHEMA_VERSION`, `REQUIRED_COLUMNS`, `initializeSchema`, `repairRequiredColumns`, `isSchemaInitialised`, `detectFtsAvailable` | ~260 |
| `persistent-store/metadata.ts` | `getMetadata`/`setMetadata`/`getAllMetadata`, last-export timestamps, delta-sync metadata | ~115 |
| `persistent-store/work-items.ts` | Work-item CRUD, `countWorkItems`, duplicate lookup, `batchUpdateSortIndices`, hierarchy ordering, `rowToWorkItem` | ~560 |
| `persistent-store/comments.ts` | Comment CRUD, `rowToComment` | ~115 |

Dependency direction after extraction: `persistent-store.ts` → {any module};
modules → `types.ts`, `sql-bindings.ts`, `../types.js`, `../status-stage-rules.js`,
`@worklog/shared/icons` and an internal context type. `fts.ts` may call
work-item/comment collaborators through the context; no module imports the
façade.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts` — reduce to façade + barrel; preserve all 11 exports.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/types.ts` — new; extracted interfaces.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/sql-bindings.ts` — new; binding/escape/waiver utilities.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/schema.ts` — new; DDL, versioning and additive repair.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/metadata.ts` — new; metadata and export/delta watermarks.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/work-items.ts` — new; item CRUD and ordering.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/comments.ts` — new; comment CRUD.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/edges.ts` — new; edge CRUD, import and transactions.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/audit-results.ts` — new; audit-result storage.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/fts.ts` — new; FTS5 index and search/fallback.
- `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/cache.ts` — new; in-memory query cache.
- `packages/shared/src/database.ts` — verify unchanged (barrel contract).
- `packages/shared/README.md` — Package Structure section.
- `docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md`, `docs/design/incremental-sync.md`, `docs/dev/sync-persist-performance.md`, `docs/dev/wal-checkpointing-investigation.md` — update file references to the new module paths.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Circular imports via the façade (medium).** A module importing
  `./persistent-store.js` would cycle through the barrel. *Mitigation:* modules
  import concrete siblings plus an internal context type; the façade imports
  downward only. Enforced by AC4 and a static import scan (no
  `madge`/`dependency-cruiser` in the repo).
- **Shared `private` state (`db`, `_cache`, `_ftsAvailable`).** Nearly every
  method touches `this.db` and the cache invalidation helpers. *Mitigation:*
  inventory every `this.` access per method before moving; express it on an
  internal context (`StoreContext`) so extracted modules stay acyclic and
  testable.
- **Behaviour drift in SQL/ordering (medium).** A large move invites silent
  edits, especially in `saveWorkItem` (24-column upsert), hierarchy ordering and
  FTS ranking. *Mitigation:* move-only rule, unchanged test suite, and a review
  pass diffing moved blocks against the original.
- **Cache-semantics drift (medium).** `invalidateWorkItemCaches` clears several
  key families; splitting may drop one. *Mitigation:* keep all invalidators in
  `cache.ts` with the existing key list, and rely on `dirty-tracking` /
  `read-cache-prune` suites.
- **Build/packaging.** `scripts/benchmark-caching.ts` resolves
  `dist/persistent-store.js`; the façade must keep that exact output path (the
  `dist/persistent-store/` sibling directory coexists safely).
- **Merge contention with WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT.** *Mitigation:* serialise the
  two items; do not run both concurrently.
- **Assumption:** the 1,000-line ceiling applies to non-test source; no test
  file exceeds it here, so no test splitting is needed.
- **Assumption:** no consumer call-site changes are acceptable, including in
  `scripts/` and `bench/`.
- **Assumption:** no behavioural improvement is bundled in; anything observed
  en route becomes a separate `discovered-from` work item.
- **Scope-creep risk (explicit).** Unifying the two `persistent-store.ts`
  forks, adding a repo-wide file-length lint, refactoring `database.ts`, or
  reorganising cache behaviour are **out of scope** and must be recorded as
  linked follow-ups rather than absorbed here.

## Related work

- **WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7** — parent sweep: every production file > 1,000 lines
  is evaluated for decomposition (producer directive, Q1 answered).
- **WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT** — sibling epic: decompose
  `packages/shared/src/database.ts` (same package/build; serialise).
- **WL-0MVGKGU19004NTHB** — sibling task: decompose `src/persistent-store.ts`
  (the divergent root fork; out of scope here).
- **WL-0MQJK4UF0002OKUD** — prior "Extract concerns from
  `SqlitePersistentStore`" (completed; its extractions landed on a feature
  branch only — precedent, not a completed change here).
- **WL-0MQPQOFVX003V32B** — Phase 1: extract `WorklogDatabase` into
  `packages/shared/` (explains why this file exists alongside the root copy).
- **WL-0MT2GITCX009WUEW** — removed `packages/herdr/src/icons.ts` and rewired
  herdr consumers (background on the `@worklog/shared/icons` import guard that
  extracted modules must keep honouring).
- Repo docs that name this file: `docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md`,
  `docs/design/incremental-sync.md`, `docs/dev/sync-persist-performance.md`,
  `docs/dev/wal-checkpointing-investigation.md`, `packages/shared/README.md`.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No producer interview questions were required: the seed context (goal, drafted
ACs, parent directive) plus repository inspection is sufficient to draft an
actionable brief, and every remaining choice is a reversible design decision
that plan/implement can adjust. The agent decisions below are recorded for
review, consistent with the sibling epic WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT.

- **Q: Does this item also cover the root `src/persistent-store.ts`?**
  **Answer (agent, by repository inspection): No.**
  Evidence: a dedicated item exists (WL-0MVGKGU19004NTHB), and the two files
  are divergent forks — the shared copy adds read-only open, audit-waiver
  parsing, the query cache and delta-sync watermarks. Scope stays on
  `packages/shared/src/persistent-store.ts`.

- **Q: Keep a barrel at `persistent-store.ts`, or update importers to the new
  modules?**
  **Chosen: keep the barrel** re-exporting the full current 11-symbol surface.
  Rationale: zero importer/test churn; consistent with the parent sweep's Q2
  answer (keep the barrel) and the sibling epic's "public API unchanged" AC.
  Re-exporting only *used* symbols was considered (parent Q2 refinement) but
  the export set is small and the module is also reached by path from
  `scripts/benchmark-caching.ts`, so full preservation is the safer move-only
  choice.

- **Q: Delivery shape — single change or an epic with sequenced children?**
  **Chosen: single `task`** (respecting the sweep's classification), delivered
  as a move-only extraction in a handful of commits (types/utilities first,
  then modules, then the façade). If plan-time analysis shows the change needs
  bisectable checkpoints, children can be created then; the choice is
  reversible and not worth blocking intake.

- **Q: What module layout?**
  **Chosen:** `packages/shared/src/persistent-store/` subdirectory behind an
  unchanged `persistent-store.ts` façade — mirroring the
  `packages/shared/src/database/` layout agreed for WL-0MVGKGHNR0019OLT. This
  keeps the two sibling refactors structurally consistent and requires no
  `tsconfig` change.

- **Q: Do any test files exceed 1,000 lines and need splitting?**

## Refactor: decompose `src/sync.ts` god class

**File:** `src/sync.ts` (1,867 lines, 34 exports)

## Problem statement

`src/sync.ts` exceeds the 1,000-line maintainability ceiling adopted for
WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 (downtime-worker.ts decomposition). It concentrates
merge logic, author-identity validation, remote fetching, delta replay and
push operations in a single module, making navigation, review and safe
change harder than necessary.

## Users

- **Developer maintaining sync** — needs to locate and edit one concern without
  scrolling 1,800 lines. *As a maintainer, I want merge logic isolated from git
  plumbing so a merge fix does not require reading push code.*
- **Code reviewer** — needs a focused diff surface per concern.
  *As a reviewer, I want to review a change confined to one cohesive file.*
- **New contributor** — needs learnable module sizes.
  *As a newcomer, I want each sync concern to be a file I can read in one sitting.*

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **No file exceeds 1,000 lines.** Every file in the resulting structure
   (barrel and extracted modules) has ≤ 1,000 lines, verified mechanically
   (e.g. `wc -l`) and recorded in the completion comment.
2. **Public API surface preserved.** All 34 existing exports remain importable
   from `'../src/sync.js'` / `'./sync.js'` (barrel re-export); no consumer
   source file or test file changes its import path or assertions.
   Verified by `tsc` build plus an unchanged test suite.
3. **Behaviour-preserving, move-only.** No logic changes; existing tests pass
   without modification. Any accidental behavioural delta must be reverted,
   not "fixed" in place.
4. **No new circular imports.** Dependency direction is acyclic and recorded in
   the module responsibility table below; verified by build plus an import-graph
   check (no module imports a module that imports it back).
5. **Module responsibilities documented.** Each extracted file carries a
   top-level JSDoc comment naming its concern.
6. **Validation.** Full project test suite passes via the test skill, and
   `npm run build` succeeds.
7. **Documentation updated.** `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (or the sync section it
   links) describes the new module layout; code comments reflect moved code.

## Constraints

- Preserve the public API exactly — barrel re-export only, no consumer edits.
- No new dependencies, no behavioural changes, no renames of exported symbols.
- Follow the existing `src/sync/` sub-module pattern (`merge-utils.ts` already
  lives there) and the `sync-defaults.ts` / `sync-phase-timings.ts` precedent.
- `src/sync/merge-utils.ts` imports `MergeOptions` from `'../sync.js'`; it may
  be re-pointed to the new types module (internal, not a consumer).
- Scope is decomposition only. Any behavioural improvement discovered is filed
  as a separate work item, not absorbed here.

## Existing state

- `src/sync.ts` — 1,867 lines, 34 exports (23 functions/consts + 11
  interfaces/types), no internal section markers; concerns are inferable from
  declaration order.
- Already extracted: `src/sync/merge-utils.ts` (52 lines, merge primitives),
  `src/sync-defaults.ts`, `src/sync-phase-timings.ts`.
- 10 source files import from `sync.js`: `database.ts`, `github-sync.ts`,
  `api.ts`, `logging.ts`, `index.ts`, `commands/{sync,doctor,init,migrate,helpers}.ts`.
- 11 test files import from `sync.js` (`sync.test.ts`, `sync-whitelist.test.ts`,
  `sync-author-gate.test.ts`, `sync-worktree.test.ts`,
  `rewrite-and-force-push.test.ts`, `sync-regression-guard.test.ts`,
  `sync-prefix-filter.test.ts`, `config-sync-allowed-authors.test.ts`, and others).
- Recent history touching the file: `f39b2463` (sync phase timings),
  `4eb0cc6b` (claim-hold guard), `09ac2db7` (audit downgrade guard) — the file
  is under active change, which raises merge-conflict risk during the refactor.

## Desired change — module plan (cycle-safe)

Extract along the existing cohesive concern groups; `src/sync.ts` becomes a thin
barrel. Est. line counts derive from the current file's declaration ranges.

| New file | Est. lines | Contents | Depends on |
|----------|-----------|----------|------------|
| `src/sync.ts` (barrel) | ~60 | Re-exports of every module below | all |
| `src/sync/types.ts` | ~100 | `GitTarget`, `SyncResult`, `MergeOptions`, `IncomingCommit`, `SyncAllowedAuthors`, `AuthorIdentityOptions`, `AuthorIdentityViolation`, `AuthorIdentityResult`, `DeltaReplayResult` | `../types.js` |
| `src/sync/git-exec.ts` | ~90 | `sanitizeGitEnv`, `gitExecAsync`, `execAsync`, `execGitCaptureStdout`, `escapeShellArg` | `../process-lifecycle.js` |
| `src/sync/merge-predicates.ts` | ~80 | `isRegressionDefault`, `isValueRegression`, `isEmptyMeaningfulField`, `isTerminalStage`, `isAttributedDelete` | `types.ts`, `merge-utils.ts` |
| `src/sync/field-merge.ts` | ~600 | `mergeSameTimestampItems`, `mergeDifferentTimestampItems`, `mergeRemoteItem`, `indexItemsById` | `merge-predicates.ts`, `merge-utils.ts`, `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/merge.ts` | ~30 | `mergeWorkItems` | `field-merge.ts`, `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/merge-collateral.ts` | ~130 | `mergeComments`, `mergeAuditResults`, `mergeDependencyEdges` | `merge-utils.ts`, `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/prefix-filter.ts` | ~70 | `isOwnProjectItemId`, `filterRemoteDataByPrefix` | `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/author-identity.ts` | ~200 | `normalizeEmail`, `isAllowAllAuthors`, `isEmailWhitelisted`, `getRemoteAuthorCommits`, `checkAuthorIdentity`, `buildIdentityRefusalMessage`, `getConfiguredUserEmail`, `enforceAuthorIdentityGate` | `git-exec.ts`, `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/refs.ts` | ~110 | `getLastSyncedRefPath`, `readLastSyncedRef`, `writeLastSyncedRef`, `getRemoteTrackingRefSha`, `getRemoteTrackingRef`, `_testOnly_getRemoteTrackingRef` | `git-exec.ts` |
| `src/sync/repo-context.ts` | ~60 | `assertDataFileInCwdRepo`, `getRepoRelativePath` | `git-exec.ts` |
| `src/sync/worktree.ts` | ~140 | `removeWorktreeFiles`, `listTrackedFiles`, `ensureDir`, `withTempWorktree` | `git-exec.ts`, `types.ts` |
| `src/sync/remote.ts` | ~200 | `getRemoteDataFileContentWithRef`, `getRemoteDataFileContent`, `replayRemoteDeltaChain` | `worktree.ts`, `git-exec.ts`, `refs.ts`, `repo-context.ts`, `../jsonl.js` |
| `src/sync/push.ts` | ~170 | `gitPushDataFileToBranch`, `rewriteAndForcePushDataFile` | `worktree.ts`, `remote.ts`, `git-exec.ts`, `repo-context.ts` |

The layering is strictly bottom-up (`types`/`git-exec` → predicates → merge →
remote/worktree → push → barrel), so no cycle is created. Note that
`mergeRemoteItem` must live in `field-merge.ts` (not `merge.ts`) to avoid a
`merge → field-merge → merge` cycle.

## Key Files

- `src/sync.ts` — Reduced to a barrel re-export preserving all 34 exports.
- `src/sync/types.ts` — Shared sync types currently interleaved with logic.
- `src/sync/git-exec.ts` — Git invocation, env sanitisation, stdout capture.
- `src/sync/merge-predicates.ts` — "is this a regression / a default" predicates.
- `src/sync/field-merge.ts` — Same- and different-timestamp field merge (largest extract).
- `src/sync/merge.ts` — Public merge entry point.
- `src/sync/merge-collateral.ts` — Comment, audit-result and dependency-edge merge.
- `src/sync/prefix-filter.ts` — Cross-project prefix filtering.
- `src/sync/author-identity.ts` — Author identity gate and whitelist logic.
- `src/sync/refs.ts` — Last-synced ref and remote-tracking ref helpers.
- `src/sync/repo-context.ts` — Data-file/repo-root resolution and assertion.
- `src/sync/worktree.ts` — Temporary worktree lifecycle helpers.
- `src/sync/remote.ts` — Remote content fetch and delta-replay chain.
- `src/sync/push.ts` — Data-file push and force-push/rewrite.
- `src/sync/merge-utils.ts` — Existing primitives; re-point `MergeOptions` import.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — Document the new sync module layout.

## Risks & Assumptions

**Risks**
- **Merge-logic interdependence** — `mergeSameTimestampItems` /
  `mergeDifferentTimestampItems` interlock with `mergeRemoteItem`; hence the
  explicit placement of `mergeRemoteItem` in `field-merge.ts`. Mitigation: keep
  the predicates in their own leaf module.
- **Test-coupling blast radius** — 11 test files import from `sync.js`; a
  single missing barrel re-export breaks them. Mitigation: mechanical export
  parity check (compare the exported symbol list before/after).
- **Concurrent-change conflicts** — `src/sync.ts` changed in the last three
  sync-related commits; a long-lived branch will conflict. Mitigation: land as
  a small number of sequential commits (types/git-exec first, then merge, then
  remote/push, then barrel), each building green.
- **Circular imports** — mitigated by the layered plan above and verified by
  build + import-graph check.
- **Scope creep** — the file contains known awkwardness (e.g. duplicated
  worktree/push preamble). Record opportunities as new work items; do not
  refactor logic here.
- **`_testOnly_getRemoteTrackingRef`** — a test-only export must survive the
  barrel unchanged; `tests/sync.test.ts` depends on it.

**Assumptions**
- Barrel re-export from `src/sync.ts` is the accepted compatibility mechanism
  (matches AC 2 in the seed brief and the existing `index.ts` pattern).
- Test files need no decomposition; only production source moves.
- Line targets are estimates; distribution may shift between
  `field-merge.ts` and `merge.ts` provided all files stay ≤ 1,000 lines.
- No performance or runtime-import-order change is expected.

## Related work

- **WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7** — downtime-worker.ts is a god class (parent refactor
  series; this item is `discovered-from` it).
- **WL-0MSGAEJQA005QG3W** — Sync invalidation and cross-instance heartbeat
  (completed; prior work in this module).
- **WL-0MV85WBZ2004VDUQ** — Assignee sync regression guard (completed; owner of
  the `isRegressionDefault` / `isEmptyMeaningfulField` semantics that move here).
- **WL-0MSKZ36MT0089UOS** — Sync must not re-timestamp audit-fresh items
  (completed; touched merge paths).
- **WL-0MVGKH9Z900178UF** — decompose `src/github-sync.ts` (sibling decomposition).
- **WL-0MVGKH6Z1000XWGJ** — decompose `src/commands/init.ts` (sibling decomposition).
- **WL-0MVGKH47T007GKN1** — decompose `packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts` (sibling decomposition).

## Related docs

- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — SQLite/JSONL sync architecture; needs the new module map.
- `docs/dev/worklog-sync.md` — sync behaviour reference (link target for the layout).
- `docs/dev/worktree-isolation.md` — relevant to `src/sync/worktree.ts` extraction.

## Appendix

- Q: How should the decomposition be structured? — Answer (repo analysis):
  Extract along the existing declaration-order concern groups into a layered,
  cycle-safe module set with a barrel re-export from `src/sync.ts`. Research:
  read all 1,867 lines' declaration ranges, the 11 test importers and 10 source
  importers; found no existing sync split beyond `merge-utils.ts`. Precedent:
  WL-0MVF3F9A7000HKP7 (same pattern for `downtime-worker.ts`).
- Q: Do test files need to change? — Answer (repo analysis): No. All 11 test
  files import from `'../src/sync.js'`, which survives as the barrel. Source:
  `rg -n "from '../src/sync.js'" tests/`.
- Q: Is `MergeOptions` a cycle risk via `merge-utils.ts`? — Answer (repo
  analysis): Yes, a type-only import from `'../sync.js'` would point at the
  barrel. Mitigation: move `MergeOptions` to `sync/types.ts` and re-point
  `merge-utils.ts` to `'./types.js'`. Source: `src/sync/merge-utils.ts:2`.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MVGKH9Z900178UF** – Refactor: decompose src/github-sync.ts god class (goal: no file > 1000 lines) (open)
- **WL-0MVGKH47T007GKN1** – Refactor: decompose packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts god class (goal: no file > 1000 lines) (open)
- **WL-0MVGKH6Z1000XWGJ** – Refactor: decompose src/commands/init.ts god class (goal: no file > 1000 lines) (open)

- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — matched: adopted, appropriate, behaviour, break, ceiling (+61 more)
